output.summary: The function processes an input buffer and computes a 32-bit value based on a bitwise transformation algorithm. It returns the inverse of the computed value if the input length is non-zero, otherwise returns 0.

claims.text: A loop runs until the input buffer is fully processed.
Implements a bitwise transformation algorithm with a 32-bit output.
Returns 0 when the input length is 0.
Returns the inverse of the computed value when the input length is non-zero.
